scope: P5 request state, message IDs and restart-safe idempotency

delivery_semantics.note: No service path sets delivery_verified; only manual device confirmations can claim target receipt.

latest_text_with_both_workers.send_worker_and_download_worker: both alive, one session each, job_state=2 after close

text.source: local message database correlated by sort_seq after the native send

emoji.source: bridge_service.py --emoji; one persistent send worker session; tracker re-read the same row for server_id

image.note: The local row appeared immediately; its server_id was later updated in place by WeChat, which is why the tracker re-reads the found row.

voice.note: Native accepted; no delivery claim. A previous attempt failed before the native call with invalid_media and made no message.

state_machine_tests.message_recorded_server_confirmed: covered against a fake source and a real database row
state_machine_tests.worker_timeout_marks_unknown: covered by send_worker result mapping; no automatic retry

limitations: Only local/server acknowledgement is observed; target receipt still needs the manual phone ledger.
A request whose message never appears becomes unknown after 60 seconds; no retry is attempted.
Media server IDs can arrive after the 120-second confirmation window; state remains message_recorded rather than being guessed.
